findings.text: OVERDUE: Phone-match attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) and sync/contact cleanup (due 2026-08-14) both unresolved — scoreboard integrity is broken without them.
OVERDUE: Renewal closed 2026-07-23 — August is a prove-it month; client scoreboard requires leads → schedules → shows → patients chain to be visible now.
CPL improved 26% to ~$11.90 with spend down 32.93%; efficiency gain is real but driven by budget cut, not creative or targeting improvement — volume dropped 9.37%.
3-day signal (Aug 15–17): leads total 12 vs 17 prior 3 days (Aug 12–14); spend collapsed to $18.51/$41.10/$34.85 from $64.90/$42.59/$21.11 — spend compression is actively suppressing volume.
GHL shows 81 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments in 28 days; 122 Meta leads are not converting to booked visits — likely an intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate phone-match attribution and sync/contact cleanup immediately — both are overdue and break the August scoreboard.

Success means: attribution gap closed and GHL contacts reconciled by 2026-08-21. Sohib to confirm completion date with Ahmed Memon and Ali Shaheer.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL pipeline — 81 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments: confirm intake process is routing leads to Lily and new hire for follow-up.
